firstPlayerRule: The group collectively chooses the active player for the first turn. The base rules do not assign a fixed first player.
clarifications: Collectively choose the active player on every turn. That player chooses an available action.

On a later turn, the previous active player may act again if everyone agrees. If the group cannot agree on the next active player, the player to the left of the last active player takes that turn. This fallback does not select the first player.
Solo play uses one adventurer; multiplayer supports 2–4 adventurers.
Choose your character and starting skills during the introductory scenario. Follow its booklet and any specific card or scenario instructions.
